cohort: The study included 946 JSY-eligible women who delivered between April and June 2012, selected through stratified random sampling from districts in West Bengal, India.
finding: Cash incentives under the Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY) were significantly associated with increased institutional delivery, especially in government institutions, with JSY-eligible women being 1.5 times more likely to deliver in government institutions.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between July 2012 and May 2013, relating to deliveries that occurred between April 2012 and June 2012.
